subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Every of the two girls will get the reward.
solution:
The correct sentence is '**Every of the two'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The part of the sentence that contains an error is:** "Every of the two"**
 
• In English, the correct phrase is** "Each of the two,**" **not "Every of the two."**
 
• **"Each" **is used when referring to individual members of a group, especially when the group is small, like two girls in this case.
 
• **"Every" **is used when referring to all the members of a group of three or more.

Therefore, the **corrected sentence** would be:* "Each of the two girls will get the reward."*
